text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — SOC2 fieldwork week is next Tue-Fri. Need a short sync: owners, staging smoke, audit-log sampling, and KMS/HSM test owners. Who can own the audit-log end-to-end check?

devon: I can take audit-log pipeline ownership for staging -> prod smoke. Plan: run 24h ingestion test + sample queries. Will need a small ACL for the auditor role.

ryan: I can pair on the KV/key rotation proof steps for HSM. Need to confirm HSM test certs are available in non-prod.

tara: Product-side: we'll freeze schema changes by Monday. Who is doing the control evidence doc for the customer-facing checklist?

sarah: @tara can you own the control evidence doc? i'll fill in the access controls section. @devon thanks — please add the sampling query and retention proof snippet.

devon: putting a quick checklist in #eng-infra and PR-ing it: 
```
- run ingest for 24h (staging)
- run sample queries: `select count(*) from audit where ts > now()-1d and event_type='auth'`
- export 3 traces for each service
- confirm retention policy config
```

aj: oncall scheduling note — i'll be primary for Tue/Wed, @ryan can you take Thu for the HSM test window?

ryan: yep i can take Thu. I'll also open a draft runbook in the repo: /runbooks/compliance/hsm-proof.md

deploy-bot: deploy started by devops-ci (devon) - staging-audit-pipeline v2.3.1 — https://ci.internal/reports/4567

sarah: two quick asks: 1) @devon can you ensure the auditor role has read-only access to the ingest logs and that we can produce an export? 2) @ryan we need a signed statement of proof-of-possession for the HSM test — outline in the runbook please.

devon: yes — will add a step to grant `auditor:read` IAM in staging and record the export path. ETA EOD Mon.

ryan: adding a short template to the runbook for PoP and signature steps. will ping security for sign-off when ready.

tara: i'll draft the control evidence doc and share a link by EOD Mon. will reference devon's export path and ryan's PoP doc.

sarah: perfect. last thing — any CRs we should prioritize before fieldwork? small one: #4823 (audit-log index name change) needs a quick review, cc @devon.

devon: seeing it now, will review this afternoon. if it's small we can merge before freeze.

sarah: thanks all. i'll collect owners + timelines into the compliance tracker and post back here. :white_check_mark:
